info.name: GeniusRX — Healthcare Hub API
info.description:
Complete API collection for GeniusRX Healthcare Hub.

**Folders:**
- Folders 1–22 contain user-facing APIs (job_seeker, recruiter, instructor)
- Folder 23 (🔐 Admin) contains all admin/super_admin-only APIs, organized by dashboard screen

**Quick start:**
1. Import this collection
2. Hit Login → tokens are saved automatically
3. All other requests use {{accessToken}}

item.name: 🔐 Admin
item.description:
All endpoints require admin or super_admin role.
Send the admin access token: Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}

Folders match the admin dashboard sidebar screens:
1. 📊 Dashboard
2. 👤 Job Seekers
3. 🏢 Recruiters
4. 🎓 Instructors
5. 💼 Job Posts
6. 💳 Subscriptions
7. 💰 Earnings
8. 🚩 Reports
9. 🔨 Moderation Log
10. ⚙️ Admin Profile
11. 📄 CMS

item.name: 📊 Dashboard
item.description: Main dashboard overview screen — summary stats cards (total users, job seekers, recruiters, instructors, total earnings, total jobs) with month-over-month change percentages and a recent users list.

request.description:
Roles: admin, super_admin
Returns: totalUsers, totalJobSeekers, totalRecruiters, totalInstructors, totalEarnings, totalJobs (each with count/amount + changePercent vs last month), plus recentUsers array (last 10 signups).
